source.title: Soul of Devouring
source.description: This soul should be an interesting one. While you were gone I've heard that a rogue felhound has been preying on some mages near Blackwood Lake. Take this special soul shard - it should amplify the effects of arcane magic cast on you. That felhound won't be able to resist it.
source.objective: Find the mages near Blackwood Lake and have them cast spells on you until the felhound appears.
source.completion: The scythe is ready at last. Just one more trial, <name>.
